correctness.rationale: The irredundant chain-polytope facets x_z>=0 and Σ_(i,j,k) x_i+x_j+x_k<=1 supply precisely coordinate rays e_z and triple rays -(e_i+e_j+e_k). The Demazure distinguished-ray inequalities force coordinate -epsilon_z roots; if the singled-out middle layer consists of one q, subsets in exactly one outer layer also give roots -epsilon_q+Σ_I epsilon_i or Σ_J epsilon_j, counting shared empty subset once. Every triple ray has another triple containing each coordinate (a,b>=2), excluding triple-distinguished roots. Standard toric Demazure theory gives torus dimension d plus these root groups. Direct derivation commutators delete subset elements and prove F⋊H=G_a^(2^a+2^b-1)⋊G_a^(a+b), class max(a,b)+1 (not inferred from root count alone). Independently enumerated all integer characters in [-1,1]^5 and [-1,1]^6 for (a,b,c)=(2,2,1),(2,2,2), finding exactly 11 and 6 roots; infinite exhaustion rests on ray inequalities.
